posts.text:
Southfield, Michigan - Toby Jacob Rhodes, 4, has been charged with a hate crime after allegedly directing violent antisemitic threats at his Jewish neighbors and their children. 

According to prosecutors, Rhodes filmed three children playing outside on March 31st while shouting statements including “All Jews are murderers,” “Always playing victim,” “Kill the Jews,” and “Kill you.” 

Oakland County Prosecutor Karen McDonald announced the charges, emphasizing that intimidation based on religion or ethnicity “will be aggressively prosecuted.” 

Rhodes is also facing separate charges from a 2025 incident in which he allegedly threatened a Jewish man while wielding a power tool and shouting antisemitic slurs. That case includes charges of assault with a dangerous weapon and ethnic intimidation, with a pretrial hearing scheduled for June 2nd.
